# `silk/schema/issue`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The problems a schema reports, and where in the value they happened.

## When to use
Match on [`Issue`](#Issue) when a codec, a check, or a format reader rejects input. Read
[`SchemaError`](#SchemaError) from `silk.schema.json.SchemaJson.decode` to show a person what failed and
where, such as `port: between 1 and 65535`.

## Details
An `Issue` is a small copyable value: a [`IssueReason`](#IssueReason), one line of static text that names what
was expected, and the byte offset of the problem when the format knows it. A `SchemaError` adds
the path from the root value to the part that failed.

Import as `Issue` with `import silk.schema.issue { Issue }`.

<a id="Issue"></a>

## `Issue`

```silk
pub struct Issue
```

One problem found while reading, writing, or checking a value.

### Details

`expected` is one line of static text that says what the schema wanted, such as `"a number"` or
`"between 1 and 65535"`. `offset` is the byte offset of the problem in the input, when the
format knows it.

<a id="Issue.reason"></a>

### Field `reason`

```silk
pub reason: IssueReason
```

Why the value was rejected.

<a id="Issue.expected"></a>

### Field `expected`

```silk
pub expected: string<'static>
```

What the schema expected, as one line of text for a person.

<a id="Issue.offset"></a>

### Field `offset`

```silk
pub offset: Option<usize>
```

The byte offset of the problem in the input, if known.

<a id="SchemaError"></a>

## `SchemaError`

```silk
pub struct SchemaError
```

A rejected value: the problem, and the path from the root value to the part that failed.

### Details

`path` names struct fields by their Silk names and list elements by their index, as
`settings.ports[2]`. It is empty when the root value itself failed.

<a id="SchemaError.path"></a>

### Field `path`

```silk
pub path: String
```

The path from the root value to the part that failed, such as `settings.ports[2]`.

<a id="SchemaError.issue"></a>

### Field `issue`

```silk
pub issue: Issue
```

The problem.

<a id="SchemaErrors"></a>

## `SchemaErrors`

```silk
pub struct SchemaErrors
```

Every problem found while reading one value, in the order they were found.

### Details

`silk.schema.json.SchemaJson.decodeAll` reports it. Every failed check is listed, and reading
stops at the first value that does not have the expected shape, which is listed last.

<a id="SchemaErrors.errors"></a>

### Field `errors`

```silk
pub errors: List<SchemaError>
```

The problems, never empty.
